# Opioid Prescribing

**Authors:** Nancy L. Kopitnik, Martin R. Huecker

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Opioids. Pain medication. Pain management. Controlled substance prescribing. These words can be challenging for prescribers. Opiates are medications used to manage everything from pain to cough to diarrhea. "Opioid" is an umbrella term that represents all compounds that bind to opioid receptors, which includes compounds derived from poppy seeds, such as morphine and codeine, as well as synthetic opioids like fentanyl. Opioid receptors are found throughout the central and peripheral nervous systems and gastrointestinal tract, regulating many body functions: pain, mood, stress, reward, gastrointestinal functions, and respiration.
